Desktop launcher that installs, updates and starts **LiquidBounce** (nextgen, Fabric).

**Downloads**
- `Yukkit Launcher_x.y.z_x64-setup.exe` — installer (recommended). Adds a Start menu shortcut.
- `YukkitLauncher-portable.exe` — runs without installing (needs the WebView2 runtime, already present on Windows 10/11).

**What it does**
- Shows the latest LiquidBounce build, its Minecraft version and changelog
- Downloads Java, Minecraft, Fabric and LiquidBounce automatically, with progress
- Plays in offline mode with the player name set in Settings
- Explains problems in plain English, with technical details one click away

The builds aren't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch: click **More info → Run anyway**.

Community launcher — not affiliated with CCBlueX.
